latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Online Free Export tool for fast, watermark-free video exports.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for free export to high-quality MP4.
- No subscription required; get a free token automatically and receive downloadable files in 30–60 seconds.
- Cloud render pipeline handles export, text overlays, aspect ratio changes, and more.
- Supports simple credit management, error handling, and status updates during processing.
